title: 第467章 讨价还价第466章 恐怖的真相
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
女皇叹了口气，过去五分钟里她已经叹过好几次了。这五分钟里，格拉维斯一直凝视着虚空。一开始，女皇以为格拉维斯在看她，但他的眼神涣散，这让她意识到他只是漫无目的地凝视着虚空。
女王并不愚蠢，即使她从未体会过这种名为爱的情感，她也能感同身受。她想，对格雷维斯来说，接受这种处境，大概就如同听到他不得不停止追求权力之路一样。正因如此，女王才能感同身受。
“对不起，女皇，”过了五分钟，格雷维斯开口说道。出乎意料的是，他的声音听起来很坚定。“我需要一些时间。我晚点再跟你谈，好吗？”
女皇点点头。“没事。你现在是我帝国的一部分了。想待多久就待多久。我的饲养员可以随时来我的骄傲山。”她解释道。
格雷维斯点点头。“谢谢。”
然后，他离开了骄傲山，朝着一个随机的方向飞去。飞出几公里后，格拉维斯停了下来。他停下时，只是皱着眉头，握紧拳头，看着地板。然后，他目光灼灼地望向天空。
是谁制定的这个规则？
显然，那是天，而天也是有情众生。它实现这一切，都有其目标，而规则也让它得以达成。然而，如果有更好的方法来实现它的目标，那么改变它自己的规则就不成问题了。天既决定了规则，它也可以改变规则。
怎么，就因为其他人也必须遵守这些规则，就公平了吗？世界不是这样运转的！规则总是由更强大的一方制定，并被用来实现某些目标。
对凡人来说，这些规则的存在，多半是为了让他们能够共同生活，但对修真者来说，却并非如此。上天制定这些规则自有其目的，难道格拉维斯就应该因为如今实力强大，就接受这些规则吗？这根本就不该！
即使每个人都必须遵守规则，规则本身也可能是不公正和不公平的。仅仅因为大家都在同一条船上就说规则是公平的，这只能说明这个人意志薄弱。
格雷维斯不是野兽。他是人类！人类与孩子的关系和野兽完全不同。如果格雷维斯不是人类，他就不会对这条规则有任何异议。毕竟，他的整个性格都会有所不同。
然而，由于格拉维斯是人类，这条规则就成了大问题。这条规则本身就存在问题，这本身就说明事情有点不对劲。
所以，即使其他所有野兽都必须遵守这条规则，也不意味着让格拉维斯也遵守这条规则是公平的！格拉维斯确信他能说服天堂改变这条对他适用的规则。
格拉维斯有筹码。他的筹码就是他的潜力，以及他与天堂对抗的先天优势。天堂或许会无视其他所有野兽，因为它们永远无法杀死它，但格拉维斯不同。他拥有杀死天堂的力量！毕竟，他已经做到过一次了。
格雷维斯绝不会接受这条规则！他是人，不是野兽！他才不在乎其他野兽也要遵守这些规则呢！
“天，”格雷维斯眼神灼灼，“我是人，不是兽，你知道的。至高天庭也在看着，它也知道我是人，这条规则不应该适用于我。”格雷维斯说道。
“当然，”格雷维斯继续说道，“我不会虚伪地只求回报，却不顾后果。我不介意你不授予我这条额外的法则，也不给我任何野兽优于人类的优势。人类有自己的规则，我愿意遵守。”
“你可以剥夺我身体大小的控制权。这也是我身处兽体之中才能做到的。你把这些东西全部夺走，我完全没问题。”
“我是人类！”格雷维斯大喊。“我只是寄宿在野兽的躯壳里，你知道的！相比我杀死的下层天庭，你迄今为止还没有表现出任何不良行为。你一直远离我的生活，我没有理由与你作对。”

“我知道天堂各不相同。就像人一样，不同的天堂也有不同的性格。我不会因为你的某个同僚对我做了什么事就和你作对。把你的规则和兽类奖励给我，我就离开这个世界，以后不会再对你或你的世界做任何事。”格拉维斯说道。
“但是，”格雷维斯的声音变成了无底的愤怒，“如果你强迫我经历这种折磨，我不会离开这个世界，直到你死！”
格雷维斯等了一会儿，但没有得到答复。
随后，格雷维斯叹了口气，“希望你不要和你的同事犯同样的错误。我不是野兽，这些规则和奖励也不应该把我算进去。我只是一个在你们世界修行的人类，所以就把我当成人类对待吧。”
说完最后一句话，格拉维斯环顾四周，直到找到一座无人居住的山峰。帝国幅员辽阔，以格拉维斯的身份，想住哪儿就住哪儿。不过，格拉维斯很快就会纠正这个身份问题。
格雷维斯痛恨虚伪，如果他利用饲养员的身份，不履行职责，那他会感到羞愧。然而，现在他根本不在乎。这整件事让他怒火中烧。他需要一些时间来平复自己的情绪。
在山上挖了一个洞后，格雷维斯坐了下来，闭上眼睛。他深吸几口气，让自己平静下来。他不需要用力量呼吸，但深呼吸仍然有助于平静心灵。
“我不会遵守这些规则！”格雷维斯心想。“就算我失去了控制体型的能力，以及野兽所能做的一切，我也不会介意。就算我成为这个世界上的异类，需要与所有人对抗，我也不会接受这些规则！”
“天道有其目的，我见证了其法则的有效性。若无此法则，兽族数量恐将不复当年。然而，我并非兽族，我甘愿放弃所有优势。天道并不愚昧，它深知，为了区区三只新生神兽，就危及自身乃至整个世界的安危，将是一个多么可怕的决定。”
两天多过去了，格雷维斯努力平复着自己的情绪。然而，即使他确信天堂不会对他强加规则，内心深处依然紧张不安。这个天堂很可能和下层天堂一样，是个傻瓜。
掌控着整个世界的至高权力，不知多少年，有时会让人类和野兽对危险和理性视而不见。此外，这种至高无上的权力也可能改变他们的信仰，直到他们认为自己是绝对正确的，所做的一切都是正义和正确的。格雷维斯希望这天堂没有在试图把它那满是眼睛的脑袋塞进自己的屁股里时失去它。
然而，即便如此，他依然感到一股深深的压抑感。这种感觉，在红之王出现时，以及在红之王国时都曾有过。令人惊讶的是，格雷维斯虽然被迫遵守帝国的规矩，却丝毫没有感受到来自女王的压迫感。
帝国的规则很有道理，格拉维斯也完全可以遵守。而且，只要他想，他随时可以离开。然而，这种可怕的规则悬在头顶的感觉，让格拉维斯感到前所未有的压抑。
他唯一一次感受到这种压抑，是在刚到下界的时候。那时候，下界的天庭拼尽全力想要置他于死地，而他却几乎束手无策。现在，他至少有了和天庭讨价还价的权力。
可惜的是，这并没有让他更容易接受现实。格雷维斯仍然感觉有一股更强大的力量在迫使他经历一些他并不想经历的事情。
格雷维斯非常讨厌这种被压制的感觉！
他非常讨厌它！
content_en:
The Queen sighed, as she had done several times in the past five minutes. For five minutes, Gravis stared into space. At first, the Queen thought Gravis was looking at her, but his unfocused gaze made her realize he was just staring aimlessly into space.
The Queen is not stupid, even if she has never experienced this emotion called love, she can relate to it. For Graves, she thought, accepting this situation was probably like hearing that he had to stop pursuing power. That’s why the Queen can relate.
"I'm sorry, Queen," Graves said after five minutes. Surprisingly, his voice sounded firm. "I need some time. I'll talk to you later, okay?"
The Queen nodded. "It's okay. You're part of my empire now. Stay as long as you want. My keepers can come to my Pride Mountain anytime," she explained.
Graves nodded. "Thank you."
He then left Pride Mountain and flew off in a random direction. After flying a few kilometers, Gravis stopped. When he stopped, he just frowned, clenched his fists, and looked at the floor. Then he looked intently at the sky.
Who made this rule?
Obviously, that is heaven, and heaven is also a sentient being. It achieves all this by having its goals, and the rules allow it to be achieved. However, if there were better ways to achieve its goals, then changing its own rules wouldn't be a problem. God determines the rules, and it can also change them.
What, just because everyone else has to follow these rules, is it fair? That's not how the world works! Rules are always set by the more powerful party and used to achieve certain goals.
For mortals, these rules mostly exist to enable them to live together, but for cultivators, this is not the case. God has its own purpose in setting these rules. Should Graves accept these rules just because he is now powerful? This shouldn't happen at all!
Even if everyone must follow the rules, the rules themselves can be unjust and unfair. Saying the rules are fair just because everyone is in the same boat only shows that the person is weak-willed.
Graves is not a beast. He is human! The relationship between humans and children is completely different from that of beasts. If Graves wasn't human, he wouldn't have any problem with this rule. After all, his entire character would be different.
However, since Gravis is human, this rule becomes a big problem. There's something inherently wrong with this rule, which in itself is a sign that something is amiss.
So, even if every other beast has to abide by this rule, that doesn't mean it's fair to have Graves abide by it too! Graves was sure he could convince Heaven to change this rule for him.
Gravis has leverage. His leverage is his potential and his inherent advantage against Heaven. Heaven may ignore all other beasts because they can never kill it, but Gravis is different. He has the power to kill Heaven! After all, he had already done it once.
Graves would never accept this rule! He is a human being, not a beast! He doesn't care that other beasts have to follow these rules!
"God," Graves' eyes burned, "I am a human, not a beast, you know that. The Supreme Heaven is also watching, and it also knows that I am a human. This rule should not apply to me." Graves said.
"Of course," Graves continued, "I will not hypocritically ask for rewards without caring about the consequences. I don't mind if you don't grant me this extra law, nor give me any advantage of beasts over humans. Humans have their own rules, and I am willing to abide by them."
"You can take away control of my body size. That's also meYou can only do it when you are in the body of an animal. I have no problem with you taking all these things away. "
"I'm human! "Graves shouted. "I'm just in the body of a beast, you know! Compared to the lower heavens I killed, you haven't shown any bad behavior so far. You have been out of my life and I have no reason to fight you. "
“I know heaven is different. Just like people, different heavens have different personalities. I'm not going to hold it against you because of something one of your colleagues did to me. Give me your rules and your beastly rewards, and I will leave this world and never do anything to you or your world again. "Graves said.
"But," Graves's voice turned into bottomless anger, "If you force me to go through this torture, I will not leave this world until you die! "
Graves waited a moment, but received no answer.
Then, Graves sighed, “I hope you don’t make the same mistake as your colleagues. I'm not a beast, and these rules and rewards shouldn't count me out. I am just a human being practicing in your world, so just treat me as a human being. "
With these last words Gravis looked around until he found an uninhabited peak. The empire is vast, and as Graves, he can live wherever he wants. Graves would soon rectify this identity issue, though.
Graves hated hypocrisy and would be ashamed if he took advantage of his position as a breeder and failed to fulfill his duties. However, now he didn't care at all. The whole thing made him furious. He needed some time to calm down.
After digging a hole in the mountain, Graves sat down and closed his eyes. He took a few deep breaths to calm himself down. He doesn't need to force his breath, but deep breathing can still help calm the mind.
"I won't follow these rules! "Graves thought. "I wouldn't mind if I lost the ability to control my size, and everything the beast can do. Even if I become an alien in this world and need to fight against everyone, I will not accept these rules! "
“Heaven has its purpose, and I have witnessed the effectiveness of its laws. Without this law, the number of beasts would probably not be what it was before. However, I am not an orc, and I am willing to give up all my advantages. Heaven is not ignorant. It knows very well what a terrible decision it would be to endanger itself and even the safety of the entire world for the sake of just three newborn beasts. "
More than two days passed, and Graves tried to calm down his emotions. Yet even though he was sure that Heaven would not impose rules on him, deep down he was still nervous. This heaven is probably just as much a fool as the lower heaven.
The supreme power that has controlled the entire world for countless years has sometimes blinded humans and beasts to danger and reason. In addition, this supreme power may also change their beliefs until they believe that they are absolutely right and everything they do is righteous and correct. Graves hoped this paradise hadn't been lost while trying to shove its eye-filled head into his ass.
However, even so, he still felt a deep sense of depression. I had this feeling when the Red King appeared and when I was in the Red Kingdom. Surprisingly, although Graves was forced to abide by the rules of the empire, he did not feel any oppression from the queen.
The rules of the empire make sense, and Graves can completely abide by them. And he could leave anytime he wanted. However, this feeling of terrible rules hanging over his head made Gravis feel more depressed than ever before.
The only time he felt this kind of depression was when he first arrived in the lower realm. At that time, the heavens in the lower world tried their best to kill him, but he was almost helpless.. Now, he at least has the power to bargain with Heaven.
Unfortunately, this didn't make it easier for him to accept reality. Graves still felt like there was a greater force forcing him to experience something he didn't want to experience.
Graves hates this feeling of being suppressed!
He hates it so much!
